hook.title: Why more salons now ask for a deposit

rejected_candidates.title: Holiday hiring plans at family-run shops

drafts.body:
Hi Dana,

From July to September, 24.8% of 140,000 bookings through our booking pages were made between 8pm and 8am, the client's local time, up 4.1 points from 20.7% a year earlier.

It adds the client's side to your Oct 14 piece, "Why more salons now ask for a deposit". Gyms and studios lead at 31.0%; clinics are lowest at 17.6%.

The report goes public Nov 10, 9am ET. You can have it first, as an exclusive: the full data, the method and an interview with me before anyone else. Can you tell me by Nov 3 whether you want it?

Method: GA4 booking events by the client's local hour; table on request.

drafts.name: Carla Nguyen

hook.title: Stop apologising for your cancellation policy

subjects: A deposit rule is a courtesy, not a penalty
What a booking should ask for up front
drafts.body:
Hi Carla,

I'd like to write this for Small Biz Voices: "A deposit rule is a courtesy to your clients, not a penalty."

Your section ran "Stop apologising for your cancellation policy" on Oct 20. Mine goes one step further: what the policy should ask for at the moment of booking, and how to word it so clients accept it.

I can back it with our own booking data: from January to June 2026, across 1,240 salons, 4.1% of 212,400 appointments at salons with a deposit rule were no-shows, against 9.6% of 388,900 at salons without one.

It is written for owners who still take bookings with no deposit, at 600 to 800 words as your guidelines ask. Would you like to see it?
drafts.signature:
Maya Chen
Co-founder and CEO, Example Booking Software
(555) 010-0144

follow_ups.text: Hi Carla, one addition: Jordan Lee, owner of Brindlewick Hair Studio in Columbus, asks every client for a deposit at booking and is happy to be quoted in the piece. Is the idea a fit for the section?
Hi Carla, our after-hours report is public now, so the piece can open on it: 24.8% of 140,000 bookings were made between 8pm and 8am. Would you like to see the piece?
